quizzes.title: Electron Configuration
quizzes.description: 30 questions on neutral atoms in the ground state. Brackets represent a noble-gas core; superscripts show electrons in each subshell.

questions.prompt: Which is the ground-state electron configuration of a neutral hydrogen atom (H)?
questions.explanation: A neutral hydrogen atom has 1 electron. Its ground-state electron configuration is 1s¹.

questions.prompt: Which is the ground-state electron configuration of a neutral helium atom (He)?
questions.explanation: A neutral helium atom has 2 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is 1s².

questions.prompt: Which is the ground-state electron configuration of a neutral lithium atom (Li)?
questions.explanation: A neutral lithium atom has 3 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is [He] 2s¹.

questions.prompt: Which is the ground-state electron configuration of a neutral beryllium atom (Be)?
questions.explanation: A neutral beryllium atom has 4 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is [He] 2s².

questions.prompt: Which is the ground-state electron configuration of a neutral boron atom (B)?
questions.explanation: A neutral boron atom has 5 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is [He] 2s² 2p¹.

questions.prompt: Which is the ground-state electron configuration of a neutral carbon atom (C)?
questions.explanation: A neutral carbon atom has 6 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is [He] 2s² 2p².

questions.prompt: Which is the ground-state electron configuration of a neutral nitrogen atom (N)?
questions.explanation: A neutral nitrogen atom has 7 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is [He] 2s² 2p³.

questions.prompt: Which is the ground-state electron configuration of a neutral oxygen atom (O)?
questions.explanation: A neutral oxygen atom has 8 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is [He] 2s² 2p⁴.

questions.explanation: A neutral fluorine atom has 9 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is [He] 2s² 2p⁵.

questions.explanation: A neutral neon atom has 10 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is [He] 2s² 2p⁶.

questions.explanation: A neutral sodium atom has 11 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is [Ne] 3s¹.

questions.explanation: A neutral magnesium atom has 12 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is [Ne] 3s².

questions.explanation: A neutral aluminum atom has 13 electrons. Its ground-state electron configuration is [Ne] 3s² 3p¹.

questions.prompt: Which is the ground-state electron configuration of a neutral silicon atom (Si)?

questions.prompt: Which is the ground-state electron configuration of a neutral phosphorus atom (P)?
